subject: Social Media
title: Bot Networks
description: A micro-lesson that makes Bot Networks usable.

hook.text: A trending hashtag gets 100,000 tweets in an hour. But 60% of those accounts were created yesterday.

buildup.text: Bot networks are cheap to build. A few thousand dollars buys millions of fake followers or retweets.

discovery.text: Bots create the illusion of consensus. When a topic trends, real humans pile on—thinking the crowd is genuine.

twist.text: Studies estimate 5-15% of Twitter accounts are bots. On some political topics, it's over 50%.

climax.text: Platforms struggle to remove bots because the same tools detect real activists in authoritarian countries.

punchline.text: If everyone seems to agree, check who's real.

quiz.question: How do bot networks influence public opinion?
options: By creating an illusion of consensus
